newsitem.title: USA: Union Texas sets ethylene expansion.
newsitem.headline: Union Texas sets ethylene expansion.

text.p: Union Texas Petroleum Holdings Inc said it plans to construct a new ethylene furnace at the Union Texas Petrochemicals-operated olefins plant at Geismar, La., as part of a $27.8 million expansion.
Nine of the facility's furnaces will be upgraded as part of the project, the company said. With the addition of the new furnace, the plant will have a total of 13 furnaces.

A major portion of the work for the new furnace and upgrading project will be performed by ABB Group's Lummus Heat Transfer, a division of ABB Lummus Global Inc, which constructed the plant's nine original furnaces.

Union Texas Petrochemicals has a 41.67 percent interest in the Geismar olefins facility, situated about 20 miles southeast of Baton Rouge. The remaining interest is held by BASF AG, with 41.67 percent, and General Electric Co's GE Plastics, with 16.66 percent.
Union Texas put its share of the costs at $11.6 million.

It said construction of the new furnace and upgrading of the nine original furnace units are expected to begin in May 1997 and be completed in February 1999. The new furnace is scheduled to begin start-up operations in the fourth quarter of 1997.

"The additional furnace will enable the Geismar plant to increase its reliability, reduce energy costs and enhance its annual production capacity by about 26 million gross pounds, or 2 percent, to approximately 1.275 billion gross pounds," said Trey Wilson, Union Texas Regional Vice President-Americas.
"With this 13th furnace, Union Texas Petrochemicals' share of ethylene production at the Geismar facility is expected to be approximately 531 million net pounds in 1998.
"This increase in production capacity will enhance Union Texas Petrochemicals' profitability into the next century."

Union Texas Petrochemicals sells its share of ethylene to several large petrochemical companies that use ethylene in the manufacture of plastics, housewares, carpet and other various consumer products. Union Texas Petrochemicals is a trade name for Union Texas Products Corp, a subsidiary of Union Texas Petroleum Holdings Inc.
